Name: Noise
Description: Group containing parameters for generating Perlin noise, a foundational procedural noise used for terrain and texture synthesis.

Name: Type
Description: Specifies the style of Perlin noise to generate, affecting the overall appearance and structure of the noise pattern.

Flubs.Name: FBM
Flubs.Description: Fractal Brownian Motion. Produces classic Perlin noise with layered octaves for natural, smooth terrain.

Flubs.Name: Ridged
Flubs.Description: Generates ridged noise, emphasizing sharp crests and valleys for more dramatic, mountainous features.

Flubs.Name: Billowy
Flubs.Description: Creates billowy, cloud-like noise with soft, rounded shapes and less pronounced valleys.

Name: Scale
Description: The scale of the noise. Higher values create larger, less detailed shapes. Lower values create noisier, highly detailed shapes.

Name: Octaves
Description: The number of noise octaves. Higher values create more complexity by layering additional detail at smaller scales.

Name: Gain
Description: Controls the amplitude reduction between octaves, affecting the persistence and contrast of the noise.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the maximum elevation or intensity of the noise, scaling the output vertically.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different noise patterns.

Name: Warp
Description: Group containing parameters for warping or distorting the Perlin noise, adding complexity and variation.

Name: Type
Description: Specifies the type of warp applied to the noise, controlling the complexity and style of the distortion.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: No warping is applied; the Perlin noise remains unaltered.

Flubs.Name: Simple
Flubs.Description: Applies basic warping to the noise, introducing gentle distortions for added variation.

Flubs.Name: Complex
Flubs.Description: Applies advanced, multi-layered warping for highly intricate and organic distortions.

Name: Frequency
Description: Controls the frequency of the warp, determining how often the pattern is distorted across the terrain.

Name: Amplitude
Description: Sets the strength of the warp effect, controlling how far the noise is displaced.

Name: Octaves
Description: The number of noise octaves. Higher values create more complexity by layering additional detail at smaller scales.

Name: Transform
Description: Group containing parameters for transforming the Perlin noise, such as scaling and translation.

Name: Scale X
Description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis, stretching or compressing the noise horizontally.

Name: Scale Y
Description: The non-uniform scale of the Y axis, stretching or compressing the noise vertically.

Name: X
Description: Offsets the Perlin noise along the X axis, shifting its position horizontally.

Name: Y
Description: Offsets the Perlin noise along the Y axis, shifting its position vertically.
